messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff: Nightingale Labs — Implementation owners & acceptance gates

Team —

Quick handoff summary for Nightingale Labs (deal closed 11/29):
- ARR: $420k annual committed usage (hosted + 2 dedicated instances)
- Go-live target: 2028-01-15 (customer requested 45-day runway)
- Primary contact: Lina Park (Head of AI Ops) — Lina will field day-to-day requests. CFO John Hauser will approve final SOW changes and invoices.

Key constraints and asks from sales:
1) Nightingale requires SOC-2 evidence for the hosted portion and a private VPC design for the dedicated instances (they want traffic segregation).
2) Data retention and audit logs: 90-day rolling logs, exportable by CSV for compliance review.
3) Two-week canary window where Stage environment mirrors Prod for sample traffic (they will send a 10k-message prompt set).

Deliverables we committed to in the contract (short):
- Implementation plan + mutual action plan (MAP) within 3 business days
- Security evidence checkpoint (SOC-2 / encryption design) within week 1
- SOW redline turnaround: 5 business days

Immediate asks for CS/ops:
- Marissa: take primary stewardship of post-signing customer engagement and own the MAP.
- Tessa: lead technical design (VPC layout + staging runbook) and coordinate infra requests with infra-oncall.
- Rishi: exec sponsor / budget questions; stay looped for any credit/discount escalation.

I've attached a first draft MAP and a high-level MOP that we used in the sale. Use these as a starting point; I flagged the sections we promised to the customer.

Attachments: Nightingale_MOP_v1.pdf, MAP_template.xlsx

Please reply with owner confirmations and any questions. I'll join the kickoff with Lina on 12/1 at 11:00 PT (sales already invited).

Thanks —
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Diego — confirming receipt. I'll own the customer-facing MAP and kickoff cadence. A few clarifying items before I loop the customer in: 

1) Acceptance criteria — do we have a short list of must-have success metrics for the 30/60/90d window beyond 'service up and responding'? Sales mentioned latency SLAs for the dedicated instance (p95 under 180ms) — can someone confirm that's in the final SOW?
2) For SOC-2 evidence, do we have an internal pack we can share or do we need to generate a tailored evidence packet for Nightingale?
3) Who is our point for infra requests (VPC peering, firewall rules) if Tessa needs faster-than-normal provisioning?

I'll draft an initial kickoff agenda and share with Lina + John after we align on the items above. I can take the 12/1 11:00 PT meeting if Diego wants to hand that off.

Marissa — answering inline with what I have from the sale and legal: 

1) Acceptance criteria: final SOW includes the following baseline (I'll paste into the MAP):
   - Prod readiness: Dedicated instance reachable and serving production traffic for the tenant with p95 <= 180ms for prompts <= 1k tokens.
   - Functional: End-to-end flow for nightly batch embedding and retrieval validated with sample set.
   - Logging: Audit logs exported and accessible for a 90-day window; weekly CSV export for compliance review available on request.

2) SOC-2 evidence: we have a redacted evidence bundle (internal) that legal will sign off to share. I'll coordinate with Security and attach the bundle to the MAP by 12/3.

3) Infra requests: Tessa will be our owner for VPC design; for expedited requests she should page infra-oncall and tag the ticket with HS-11297-EXPEDITE. Rishi — can you confirm escalation path for any spend-related provisioning that exceeds baseline?

I've attached the drafts; Lina/John — feel free to review the MAP prior to kickoff (link below). If anything here contradicts the SOW you saw, flag it and we'll correct immediately.

Attachments: Nightingale_MOP_v1.pdf (design notes), MAP_template.xlsx

Diego

Hi all — thanks for the context. I'm taking technical ownership of the implementation design and sprint plan. High-level timeline and owners below: 

- Week 0 (12/1 kickoff): confirm MAP, security checklist, and SOW line items (Owner: Marissa)
- Week 1 (12/4–12/10): VPC design, firewall requirements, infra tickets opened (Owner: Tessa)
- Week 2 (12/11–12/17): Staging deploy + canary with customer test set (Owner: Tessa + Nightingale eng)
- Week 3 (12/18–12/24): Final performance tuning, runbook handoff, acceptance tests (Owner: Marissa / Tessa)

Acceptance gates (must pass to progress to Prod):
- Gate A: Stage smoke test — 99% of sample prompts return expected response format and errors < 1%
- Gate B: Performance — p95 latency <= 180ms under agreed sample load
- Gate C: Security — evidence packet received and any outstanding items triaged with Security within 5 business days

Operational notes:
- I'll open infra ticket HS-11297 today and tag as P1 for the peering request.
- Requesting CS to provide 3 customer contacts (eng, sec/compliance, procurement) for the MAP; Lina, please confirm who should be invited.

Marissa — I'll drop a first-pass VPC diagram in the Drive link and update the MAP by EOD Friday. Diego — please remove the 12/1 meeting from your calendar and I'll take notes / action items.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
